fightSong.title: Cheese Inside
fightSong.lyrics: Don't bite till the cheese is hot / Minnesota, we hit the spot / Juicy Lucy, molten core / Lakers gonna score some more!

stadium.name: The Skillet
stadium.tradition: The Cheese Pull — a giant Juicy Lucy is cut open on the videoboard pre-game. If the cheese stretches across the screen, we win.

fanCulture.description: They wait 10 minutes before eating anything (to avoid burning). After touchdowns they yell 'HOT!' It's Minnesota nice, until it's not.
fanCulture.tailgate: In a heated garage, with hotdish.

rivalries.name: The Frozen Tundra Deep-Dish
rivalries.narrative: They layer pizza, we stuff burgers. It's a casserole war.

cityFlavor: 10,000 lakes, one perfect burger. We do winter right.
